"The construction of this law and the meaning of the phrase \"dwelling in the United States\" has been the subject of much consideration in the executive department"; "The department seems to have followed a rule established at an early period"

"It is urged that this seems a harsh application of the law, but if the terms of the statute are to be extended to include children of a naturalized citizen who have never dwelt in the United States, such action must come from legislation of Congress and not judicial decision. ... it is only for the courts to apply the law as they find it."
